lines.en: Swimming through water
Giant body slicing the surface
Diving for food
Rolling through waterweeds
Slithering swiftly in water
Stretching in the water
Seeking prey
Patience in the water
Skin shed for speed
Master of obsidian tools

lines.zh: 蛇身在水底拐出长长的弯。
lines.en: My body bends in a long curve underwater.
I glide over the riverbed and stir the silt.
I slip out along the edge of the weeds.

lines.zh: 肌肉一节一节推动身体。
lines.en: My muscles push my body segment by segment.

lines.zh: 尾巴一摆，窜出好几格远。
lines.en: One flick of my tail carries me far.

lines.zh: 我在水面留下一道细纹。
lines.en: I leave a thin seam on the water's surface.

lines.zh: 我从倒木下面钻过去，水纹一晃。
lines.en: I slip under the fallen trunk and the ripples spread.
My scales rasp against the river stones.
Lying in waterweeds
Sinking below the surface
Circling on the surface
Patience for prey
Basking in sunlight
Swimming into depths

lines.zh: 我的身体在陆上撑不住。
lines.en: My body can't hold up on land.
Occasionally surfacing to breathe
Relaxing in the water
Slithering on the surface
I rest my head on the weeds.
Only my snout breaks the surface.
I coil quietly beside a sunken log.
Water passes my gills; I breathe slowly.
Half-lidded, I sway with the current.
I wait for the underwater light to fade.
Noticing the player nearby
Coiled on the riverbed, only my head shows.

lines.zh: 我把头缩回水里，只留眼睛。
lines.en: I sink my head back, leaving only my eyes above.

lines.zh: 我竖起前半身，水滴成线。
lines.en: I rear up, water falling off me in lines.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在浅水上，我看见了。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on the shallows and I see it.

lines.zh: 离了水，我一步也挪不动。
lines.en: Out of water, I cannot move a step.

lines.zh: 离开水，这身肌肉就撑不住。
lines.en: Out of water, these muscles cannot hold me.
That long shadow on the riverbed is me.

lines.zh: 水里是我的地盘，岸上不是。
lines.en: Water is mine; land is not.

lines.zh: 我贴着河底靠近，泥都浑了。
lines.en: I creep along the riverbed, mud clouding behind me.
You are on land; I cannot reach you there.
Once in the water, you cannot outpace me.
Pressure hurts!
I'm sinking!
My scales are peeling!
Too heavy!

lines.zh: 我需要食物，肌肉撑不住了。
lines.en: I need food, my muscles cannot hold.
Too dangerous!

lines.zh: 在水里我很大，岸上不行。
lines.en: Huge in water. Useless on land.

lines.zh: 我这条长身子，得在水里养伤。
lines.en: This long body heals in water.
I am stranded in the shallows and cannot move.
The water is so cold I nearly stiffen.
Swing underwater to lure you closer!
Slippery skin, alluring!
Swim on the surface, tempting you to take a risk!

lines.zh: 蜕皮做成护甲，速度无匹！
lines.en: Armor made from shed skin, unmatched speed!

lines.zh: 吞下食物，消化缓慢但持久！
lines.en: Eat slowly, but the nourishment lasts!

lines.zh: 叫声低沉，警告入侵者远离！
lines.en: Low rumbles warn intruders to stay away!

lines.zh: 栖息在水草间，享受独处！
lines.en: Dwell among water plants, enjoying solitude!

lines.zh: 攻击时发出嘶嘶声，展示力量！
lines.en: Sibilant hiss shows strength during attacks!

lines.zh: 蜕皮后，速度更上一层楼！
lines.en: Speed increases after shedding skin!

lines.zh: 蛋白石武器更易对你生效！
lines.en: Lapis tools work better on you!
The water is my ground.
Can you even lift my shed skin?
In full scale armor, you swim like a fish.

lines.zh: 蛋白石在我身边格外亮。
lines.en: Opal shines brighter near me.

lines.zh: 别在岸边伸手，我会拖你下来。
lines.en: Do not reach from the bank; I will pull you in.
The colder the river, the worse my temper.
Startle you with a collision!
Strong muscles can break barriers!
Water sprints, hard to avoid!
Body collisions during attacks!
Splash water at you!
Hard body, difficult to knock down!
Surprise with speed!
Surprise you with a collision!
Powerful underwater collisions!

lines.zh: 肌肉力量，让你难以招架！
lines.en: Muscular strength, hard to resist!
Search for a mate, swimming around!
Incubate eggs after laying them!

lines.zh: 在水中找到伴侣，最自在！
lines.en: Most comfortable finding a mate in water!
Cling to each other during mating!
Stop moving after laying eggs!
Search for a mate, protect the eggs!
Stop swimming after laying eggs!

lines.zh: 在水中找到合适的伴侣！
lines.en: Find a suitable mate in water!
Lay eggs and guard them quietly!
Find a mate to ensure offspring!

lines.zh: 巨大鳞片轻轻划过水面。
lines.en: Giant scales glide over the water.

lines.zh: 我闻到了你的气息，快投降吧。
lines.en: I can smell you. Surrender now.
Slough, slough, new power.
Shadow gliding among the rocks.

lines.zh: 水里没人追得上我这具长身子。
lines.en: No one in the water outruns this long body.
Lapis, my favorite.

lines.zh: 这块蜕下的皮，我留着有用。
lines.en: This skin I shed is still of use to me.
Breathe beneath the surface.
Slough, symbol of power.
King of the water, Palaeolophis.
I sense your presence.

lines.zh: 岸边的震动传到我鳞片上。
lines.en: The shaking on the bank reaches my scales.

lines.zh: 你听见水响的时候，我已在身边。
lines.en: By the time you hear the water, I am beside you.
Prey in my grasp.

lines.zh: 水底忽然安静，是我要来了。
lines.en: The riverbed goes quiet — that is me coming.
Your struggle is in vain.

lines.zh: 你走下河岸，就等于进了我的嘴。
lines.en: Stepping down that bank puts you in my jaws.
Run, it's too late.
You can't escape my shadow.
I wait in the shallows for you to misstep.

lines.zh: 我把身体盘紧，像一根压下的簧。
lines.en: I coil tight like a pressed spring.

lines.zh: 我把头抬出水面，嗅你的脚。
lines.en: I lift my head from the water to scent your feet.
My attack will make you tremble.
Your end is near.
Prepare for my wrath.
I'll tear you apart.

lines.zh: 这片水里，我比你先转身。
lines.en: In this water, I turn before you do.

lines.zh: 我上了岸就撑不住身子。
lines.en: On land my body cannot hold itself up.
My strike cannot be stopped.
This channel is too narrow for me to turn in.
Hisss, get away!

lines.zh: 我这条长身子，离水就沉。
lines.en: This long body of mine sinks without water.

lines.zh: 大牙咬进你的护腿，甩头。
lines.en: My fangs sink into your greave and I twist my head.

lines.zh: 我从水里冲出半个身子咬你。
lines.en: Half my body surges out of the water to bite.
Hisss, taste my fangs!
Move or I'll bite you!

lines.zh: 陆上撑不起身子，水里才是我的。
lines.en: On land I can't lift myself. Water is mine.

lines.zh: 我的身子在岸上撑不起来。
lines.en: On land my body cannot lift itself.

lines.zh: 我在水里才有力气，别逼我上岸。
lines.en: My strength is in the water — do not force me ashore.
Watch out for my big fangs!
A large shadow appears on the water...
Ripples and a Palaeolophis emerges!
Something is moving beneath the water...

lines.zh: 水里钻出一个庞然大物...
lines.en: A massive figure emerges from the water...
Ripples spread across the water...
A large figure is in the water...

lines.zh: 水波中显现出一个大蛇...
lines.en: A large snake appears in the ripples...
Ripples spread across the water...
A cloud of mud churns up from the riverbed.

lines.zh: 一条长影贴着河床滑过。
lines.en: A long shadow slides along the riverbed.

lines.zh: 水面无声地裂开一道纹。
lines.en: The surface parts without a sound.
The weeds all lean to one side.
Fire burns me!
Carried away!

lines.zh: 水压让我喘不过气，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Pressure hurts! — and the drown makes it worse.
Water splash!

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我的侧腹，水红了。
lines.en: An arrow sinks into my flank and the water reddens.
Magic hit!

lines.zh: 我快沉下去了，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: I'm sinking! — and the starvation makes it worse.
Even in water, the lightning finds me.
Void pull!
